title: BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows
summary: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $299.8 million on Wednesday, their fifth straight day of outflows, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $269.7 million and about 94% of November's withdrawals. This post BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
